title: A category name still needs 3 characters and must be unique
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Wheel Seals.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Type category A's name in capitals.
  4. Click Create Category.
  5. Replace the name with ab.
  6. Click Create Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page lists category A.

Step 2:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in capitals.

Step 4:

  • An error reads "A category called", the typed name, "already exists".
  • No category is created.

Step 5:

  • The name reads ab.

Step 6:

  • An error shows on the name.
  • The New Category page stays open.
